title: A registration without a name or a valid email is rejected
when: A registration without a name, without an email, with a blank name or with a malformed email.
then: Each is refused with a message naming the name or the email, and the email is still free afterwards.

title: Registering an email that is already registered is refused, saying the email is taken
when: A second registration with the same email in another case.
then: It is refused, and the message says the email is already registered.

title: A registration shows the new member with their ID
when: Registers `Mo` with `mo@example.org`.
then: The registration shows a whole-number ID, the name and the email.

title: A tool without a name is rejected
when: Adds a tool with a description but no name, then opens the catalog.
then: Adding a tool without a name is refused with a message naming the name, and the catalog stays empty.

title: A new tool is in good condition and available in the catalog
when: Adds a tool with a name and a description, then opens the catalog.
then: The catalog shows the new tool as `good` and `available`.

title: An added tool reads the same in the catalog
when: Adds ` Ladder ` and lists the catalog.
then: The added tool is shown exactly as the catalog then lists it.

title: A loan is shown with its due date, a date 14 days ahead
when: Borrows a tool at the test clock's start, then another at 23:30 on 2 March in New York.
then: The loan shows `dueDate` the New York date 14 days later (`2026-03-16`). A borrow at 23:30 in New York, when UTC is on the next day, is due on the New York date plus 14.

title: An unavailable tool is refused with the reason
when: Lends one tool and reports damage on another, then has a second member borrow each.
then: Borrowing a tool on loan says it is already on loan; borrowing a damaged tool says it needs repair.

title: A member who cannot borrow is refused with the reason
when: Has a member with 3 loans borrow a fourth tool, and another member borrow at 23:59 on a loan's due date in New York and again at 00:00 the next day.
then: A member with 3 loans is told they hold 3 active loans. A member can still borrow at 23:59 on a loan's due date in New York, and is told of the overdue loan from 00:00 the next day.

title: An unknown member or tool is reported as not found
when: Borrows with an unknown member, then with an unknown tool.
then: An unknown member, and an unknown tool, are each named as not found.

title: A return without a valid condition is rejected
when: Returns a loan with no condition, then with the condition `fine`, and opens the catalog.
then: A return with no condition or an unknown one is refused with a message about the condition, and the tool stays on loan.

title: A tool returned in good condition is available again
when: Returns a loan in good condition, opens the catalog and has another member borrow the tool.
then: After a return in good condition the catalog shows the tool `available`, and another member can borrow it.

title: A good return leaves a tool needing repair when damage was reported during the loan
when: Damage is reported on a lent tool, then the loan is returned as `good`.
then: The tool still shows `needs_repair`.

title: A tool returned needing repair is taken out of lending
when: Returns a loan as `needs_repair` with a note, opens the catalog and has another member borrow the tool.
then: After a return needing repair, borrowing the tool is refused as `tool_needs_repair`.

title: A return on a day after the due date is flagged as late
when: Lends two tools to a member, returns one at 23:59 on the due date in New York and the other at 00:00 the next day.
then: A return at 23:59 on the due date in New York (already the next day in UTC) has `late: false`; a return at 00:00 the next day has `late: true`.

title: The librarian finds the loan from the tool brought back
when: Lends a tool to a member and finds its loan from the tool, then looks for the loan of a tool never lent.
then: The loan found is the member's, with its due date; for the tool never lent the librarian is told it is not on loan.

title: A librarian marks a tool as needing repair, and must give a note
when: Reports damage on a tool without a note, then with the note ` Cord frayed `, and opens the catalog.
then: Without a note it is refused with a message about the note; with one the catalog shows the tool `needs_repair` with the note.

title: Damage reported during a loan does not end the loan
when: Reports damage on a tool on loan, opens the catalog, then returns the loan as `good`.
then: After damage is reported on a lent tool, it still shows `on_loan`, and the loan can be returned.

title: A tool after damage is reported reads the same in the catalog
when: Adds ` Ladder `, reports damage on it and reads its catalog entry.
then: The tool after damage is reported is shown exactly as the catalog then lists it.

title: Marking a tool repaired returns it to lending
when: Marks a tool in good condition repaired, then reports damage on it, marks it repaired and borrows it.
then: Repairing a good tool is refused as not needing repair; repairing a damaged tool makes it `good` and `available`, and it can be borrowed.

title: A repaired tool reads the same in the catalog
when: Adds ` Ladder `, reports damage on it, marks it repaired and reads its catalog entry.
then: The repaired tool is shown exactly as the catalog then lists it.

title: The tools waiting for repair are listed, the longest waiting first, with what is wrong
when: Adds four tools, reports damage on three of them on three days (the second while it is on loan), and opens the tools waiting for repair.
then: The three damaged tools are listed, the oldest report first, each with its damage note; the tool in good condition is not.

title: A waiting tool still out on loan is shown as on loan
when: As in TL-LEND-UC07-R01-T01, opens the tools waiting for repair.
then: Only the tool damaged while on loan is shown as on loan.

title: A renewal moves the due date 14 days on and tells the member the new one
when: Lends a tool, renews the loan 10 days in and finds the loan from the tool.
then: The renewal shows the new due date, 30 March, 14 days after 16 March, and the loan now has it.

title: An overdue, returned or unknown loan is refused a renewal with the reason
when: Lends two tools, returns one, and once the other is overdue renews loan 999, the overdue loan and the returned one.
then: Each is refused, saying there is no such loan, that it is overdue or that it was already returned; the overdue loan keeps its due date.

title: A second renewal is refused, saying the loan was already renewed
when: Lends a tool and renews the loan twice.
then: The second renewal is refused, saying the loan was already renewed.

title: A month's loans, late returns, repairs and borrowers are counted
when: Records a month of loans, one returned late, one on a tool needing repair, one renewed into the next month, and a repair, and measures that month.
then: The month's loans per tool, share late, repairs with their median days and active members are counted from those records, each with the counts behind it.

title: A month not written YYYY-MM is refused
when: Measures the months 2026-3, 2026-13 and March.
then: Each is refused as not a month, and nothing is counted.
